name: Bibchik's Eleven HUD
summary:
Bibchik's Eleven HUD provides real-time opponent intelligence while playing Eleven Table Tennis.

Features:
• See opponent ELO, match count, and friendly rating before the match starts
• Head-to-head record and win percentage history
• Opponent paddle settings including rubber type, bounce, friction, and throw values

Premium features ($0.99/month):
• Detailed paddle intel with lab calibration data
• Head-to-head statistics
